# v0.2.0

## The setup form can find the wallbox

The Modbus address and the bus parameters are configurable with the MENNEKES
configuration tool, so an installation somebody inherited rarely uses the
factory values. Until now the integration asked the user to guess them, and
answered a wrong guess with "cannot connect".

The setup form now has a last field that decides what happens when the values
entered do not work:

- **Search every device address** — tries all documented addresses from 10 to
  50 at your bus parameters. About twenty seconds.
- **Search every address, baud rate and frame** — every documented
  combination. Several minutes, and it says so before it starts.
- **Do not search** — report the error, as before.

It runs as a progress step, tries the values you entered first, and shows what
it found — address, bus parameters, Modbus layout and serial number — before
creating anything. It only reads the layout register, so it cannot put a
wallbox into the energy-manager error state.

The shipped `smoke_modbus.py` check is still there for the case where the bus
itself is suspect and you want an answer outside Home Assistant.

## Documentation

- **[Entity reference](../../blob/main/docs/entities.md)** — every entity,
  what it means, its unit and class, what the wallbox has to support for it to
  exist, and the enumerated states automations will see. Generated from the
  entity descriptions, and the build fails when an entity is missing from it.
- **[Automations](../../blob/main/docs/automations.md)** — working recipes for
  PV surplus charging, pause and resume with the manufacturer's hysteresis,
  dynamic load management, cheap tariff windows, single-phase switching,
  noticing a §14a downgrade and recovering from a lost heartbeat.
- **[Troubleshooting](../../blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)** — worked
  through in the order a fault actually presents itself, from swapped A/B
  wiring down to a slider that jumps back.
- **[Index](../../blob/main/docs/README.md)** — reading paths instead of a
  pile of files.

Nothing in the device contract changed. Existing entries, entity ids and
automations are unaffected.
